liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Comes A Time** (3 reviews): Starts from a standstill, and the jam coming out of it is extended and pleasant; The jam out of it is fast and recalls Eyes of the World [8][9][18]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Includes the 'full circle' line, recalling when the whole That's It for the Other One suite was played; A funky riff recurs in the jams, and tension is high when they return to The Other One [8][16]
- **Jam** (1 review): The second set jam is rated as good as anything the band ever did; the rest falls slightly short [13]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): The second encore Not Fade Away closes the show strongly after the Other One>Eyes>Other One sequence [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1976-07-17.157427.mtx.motb.0201.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 156 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd76-07-17.menke.minches.18389.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer prefers the sound of the audience tape to the soundboard; This audience recording is very distant; Audience tape is a little hissy and not the master, so some slack is needed [13][15][16][19]
- **gd1976-07-17.mtx.chappell.sb25.95734.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 157 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd1976-07-17.mtx.chappell-bertrando.91827.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- Donna was absent for all of set II, yet the band seemed fine [10]
- Reviewer thinks this show is better played than the following night's [9]
- The following night may overshadow this show, but this one stands on its own [10]
- Overshadowed by the next night's show, but reviewer ranks it with the Boston Music Hall show, though sound and show are not as good [11]
- First set lacks the punch of some other 1976 shows, but set II from Comes A Time on is superb [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1976-07-17.157427.mtx.motb.0201.flac16**: taped by Taped By: Bob Menke; transferred by Transfer By: Bob Menke Mastering By: Derek McCabe; source: Analog Soundboard Source: gd76-07-17.sbd.34708 Analog Audience Source: ECM 280's 152 [1]
- **gd76-07-17.menke.minches.18389.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by David Minches; source: Audience Recording: Sony ECM-270s> Sony TC-152 from front of balcony [2]. Also: Lineage runs MAC to R to D to WAV to SHN, via David Minches [2]
- **gd1976-07-17.mtx.chappell.sb25.95734.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [6]. Also: Soundboard is a fix of shnid 34708/243: master reel to DAT to CD, fixed by Bill Tetzeli with a crossfaded Eyes patch; Matrix of Menke's audience tape with the soundboard, converted by David Minches, with info file by Matt Vernon; Rob Bertrando suggested it [6]
- **gd1976-07-17.mtx.chappell-bertrando.91827.sbeok.flac16**: taped by itch Correction & Slight Bass Boost processed by Rob Bertrando. Final matrix seed discs provided by Rob Betrando EAC > FLAC by Noah Weiner; source: Matrix Ratio: 60%(SBD) / 40%(AUD) [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Ticket - Orpheum Theatre S.F., CA 18 July 1976](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/ticket-orpheum-theatre-s-f-ca-18-july-1976) [21]
